proposals.research_question: Can the failure of an orientation-only SERS proxy be predicted quantitatively from an independently calibrated spectral-selectivity index?
proposals.mechanistic_hypothesis: Spectrally selective excitation/Stokes near-fields and spatial hotspot sampling cause systematic departures from an orientation-only response model.
proposals.restricted_null: Once orientation distribution and geometry are held fixed, relative band ratios need no wavelength-selective weighting correction.
proposals.known_physics_envelope: Standard frequency-resolved EM enhancement and tensor response already explain such corrections; this is quantitative regime calibration, not a new law.
independent_variables: dimensionless spectral-selectivity index χ from independent optical mapping
proposals.observable: Normalized prediction error on vector of polarization-resolved log band ratios.
proposals.quantitative_or_ordinal_prediction: Define e0(λ,d)=||log R_obs−log R_M0||_Σ, χ(λ,d)=||log R_M1−log R_M0||_Σ, using Σ from independent measurement noise; predict that sign and scale of observed e0 differences agree with pre-fitted spectral M1 on holdout, without imposing monotonicity or universal χ threshold.
assumptions: Raman tensor orientation distribution separately characterized
Field spectra calibrated without fitting test band ratio
controls: independently measured wavelength-dependent excitation and Stokes near-field spectra
independent orientation and site occupancy distributions
proposals.intervention: Vary λ and capping thickness while holding or tracking orientation/chemistry.
proposals.heldout_test: Set uncertainty-weighted norm, priors and practical effect boundary on training wavelengths. Do not fit χ from measured SERS band ratios. Evaluate e0 and the full band-vector predictive distribution under withheld λ×d combinations and negative-control spectrally flat field regimes.
proposals.local_falsifier: Predeclared heldout e0 versus independently mapped χ fails outside bounded predictive intervals for the specified wavelength, capping, orientation and chemistry domain; rejects only this quantitative calibration, not broad EM physics or orientation effects.
proposals.surviving_uncertainty: No universal transition threshold or new physics is implied by a smooth predictive crossover.
proposals.development_value: Develops a falsifiable quantitative map of the reliability domain of orientation proxies.

proposals.research_question: At fixed stationary site occupancy, how does exchange-rate scaling affect time-window SERS statistics?
proposals.mechanistic_hypothesis: Site exchange kinetics alter temporal covariance even when stationary pooled mean intensities remain unchanged.
proposals.restricted_null: Stationary 2-state CTMC with rates α,β, emissions A_k,s, and fixed π; scaling both rates c preserves pooled mean but changes covariance decay.
proposals.known_physics_envelope: Known Markov spectral diffusion/adsorption kinetics predict rate-dependent correlation and finite-window variance; novelty requires residual effect beyond a calibrated kinetics null.
independent_variables: exchange relaxation rate λ=α+β measured independently
proposals.observable: Intensity autocovariance C_kl(u), finite-window variance Var(Ibar_k,T), pooled band ratio and per-window ratio distribution kept distinct.
proposals.quantitative_or_ordinal_prediction: At fixed π and emissions under common rate scale λ→cλ, pooled ratio E[I1]/E[I2] is invariant. Centered cross-band covariance C12(u)=π1π2ΔA1ΔA2 exp(−cλ|u|); finite-window covariance is 2C12(0)[T/(cλ)−(1−exp(−cλT))/(cλ)^2]/T². Test both sign and window dependence, not an unjustified mean-ratio shift.
assumptions: State-specific emissions and π are fixed under kinetic perturbation
controls: stationary occupancy and separate state-emission estimate
proposals.intervention: Change exchange kinetics at fixed π using independently verified perturbation; measure multiple T.
proposals.heldout_test: Pre-register 3 acquisition-window lengths T and at least 2 kinetic-rate conditions with independent λ and π measurements. Calibrate state emission and detector transfer once on training data; freeze values to predict withheld T, cross-band covariance and ratio distribution with confidence intervals. Include inactive-site/no-adsorption negative control.
proposals.local_falsifier: For fixed π, ΔA and independently measured cλ, systematic violation of preregistered cross-band covariance curves across heldout T rejects the stated two-state stationary kinetics and detector model only; zero pooled ratio shift does not reject exchange dynamics.
proposals.surviving_uncertainty: Per-window ratio mean may change even when pooled ratio does not; complex multistate memory can violate the two-state null.
proposals.development_value: Identifies a tractable, quantitative temporal measurement program within known stochastic SERS physics.

provenance: Analyst-specified quantitative revisions for two high-value seed branches; does not certify physics.
